data.navTitle: 返回门口、散落包装与废物说明牌
data.title: A wrapper beside the gate

memoryNodes.cue: Actions and places are named together.

data.situation:
The rain stopped as they reached the gate again. A wrapper lay beside the path: litter, although it was only one small piece. Maya put it in the bin indicated by Ruth. A notice called the collected waste refuse; the word did not mean refusing a request here. Below it were instructions for waste disposal. Visitors were asked to dispose of their rubbish in the proper bins and never dump it behind the hut. Jo noticed that a clear instruction needed both the action and the place. Jo: Can I dispose of this wrapper here?
Ruth: Yes, in that marked bin.
Maya: What about the larger waste behind the cupboard?
Ruth: Staff arrange its disposal. Please do not move it.

readingBlocks.zh: 雨停时，她们回到门口。小径旁一张包装纸就是散落垃圾，虽然只有一小张。玛雅把它放进露丝指出的桶。通知把收集废物叫refuse，此处并非拒绝请求。下面是垃圾处理说明，要求访客在合适的桶里处置垃圾，不能丢到小屋后。乔注意到明确指示既需要动作，也需要地点。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：能在这里处理这张包装纸吗？
露丝：可以，放那个标记桶。
玛雅：柜子后大件废物呢？
露丝：工作人员安排处理，请别动。

glossary.zh: 散落在公共场所的垃圾
glossary.note: 通常不可数；一窝幼兽义未计。
glossary.example: A wrapper lay beside the path as litter.
glossary.exampleZh: 包装纸作为散落垃圾躺在小径旁。

externalEvidence.definition: rubbish carelessly dropped or left about (especially in public places)

glossary.note: 名词常读/ˈrefjuːs/，与拒绝动词读音和意义区分。
glossary.example: The notice described the collected waste as refuse.

externalEvidence.label: Collins Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Noun unwanted waste; official/formal usage and contrasting pronunciation verified.

glossary.zh: 去除、处理不需要东西的行为
glossary.note: disposal of waste；不是可随意扔弃。
glossary.example: Staff arrange the disposal of larger waste.
glossary.exampleZh: 工作人员安排大件废物处理。

externalEvidence.definition: the act or means of getting rid of something

glossary.zh: 处理、去除不需要的东西
glossary.note: 处置义须用dispose of；原资料单列dispose，教学整体搭配。
glossary.example: Can I dispose of this wrapper here?
glossary.exampleZh: 能在这里处理这张包装纸吗？

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Get rid of something, not settle a case.

glossary.note: dump waste/rubbish；不等于所有规范处置。
glossary.example: Never dump rubbish behind the hut.
glossary.exampleZh: 不要把垃圾丢在小屋后。
